objectives: Explain why the strange gods had to be put away before Bethel.
Describe the confirming of the name Israel and the promise of kings.
Explain how Reuben lost the birthright.
takeaways: Put away the strange gods and be clean: hidden idolatry in the household must go before you can stand at Bethel.
The terror of God was on the cities; the angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear Him (Psalms 34:7).
A nation and a company of nations and kings shall come out of Israel's loins; Christ made us kings and priests (Revelation 1:5-6).
Rachel died bearing Benjamin, the son of the right hand, the twelfth son.
Reuben defiled his father's bed, and his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph (1 Chronicles 5:1).
